We are a group of researchers passionate about AI, predictive analytics, and large language models. 

## Join Us
Currently, we have **one open Ph.D. position** and **multiple open positions for undergraduate researchers** to join our lab. If you are interested in AI, LLMs, or sequential data modeling, please send me an email with your CV and a brief description of your research interests.
